title: mixcore core API v0.4: result of Gesture(commandJSON)
description: Gesture takes the same command as Apply, enforces the same rules, and answers at once what the core did (CR-22): the UI draws the core's value and state instead of assuming its candidate was applied, and plays the haptic from state. On an error code (ERR_NEEDS_CONFIRM, ERR_SHOW_MODE, ERR_GAIN_BOUND, ...) there is no result.

state.description: free: applied as asked. atWall: stopped at the slip-guard wall (rigid haptic once per arrival; 'Pause to go further'; openWall after a 300 ms rest). atCap: stopped at a Gain cap of the gesture (+3 / -6 dB; never opens: 'Lift and drag again'). atCeiling: stopped at the monitor ceiling ('Max set by your engineer'; never opens). locked: show mode stopped a Gain raise ('Raising Gain is locked in show mode').

value.description: The value the core applied (set, openWall) or the start (holdBegin). For set it may differ from the command's value.

written.description: A write left for the console (false for holdBegin, holdEnd, openWall, settings and a set that changed nothing).

window.description: The active gesture window (holdBegin, set within a hold, openWall). Absent outside a hold.

wallUpDB.description: Slip guard: the next upward stop (max(start, -16) + 6 dB, then 6 dB more per openWall).

ceilingDB.description: Monitor ceiling: engineer's latest value + headroom.

opensByRest.description: Only a slip-guard wall opens by rest (never Gain, never a ceiling).
